findings.text: The "Test the proposed pure comparison" paragraph asks for a baseline comparison function with tests on a sketched contract, plus a "deterministic baseline comparison" in the design record. The present problem is attribution feasibility, and the task itself says the production task fixes the baseline contract later. Fix: keep the baseline comparison as a written sketch in `docs/s7-proof-cost-findings.md`, and drop the pure-comparison tests, or name the present problem that they solve.
